gloss: self-sufficiency; being content with what one has

definitions.gloss: self-sufficiency; meeting one's own needs; being content with what one has
definitions.explanation: Supplying one's own needs or being satisfied with what one already has — without seeking more from outside. Most commonly seen in the four-character compound {自給自足|じきゅうじそく} (self-sufficiency).

examples.japanese: {自給|じきゅう}{自足|じそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧。
⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自足|じそく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We supply our own vegetables from a small field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自足|じそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧だ。
examples.english: In modern urban life, it is nearly impossible to be self-sufficient in food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{自足|じそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In the mountains, they continue a self-sufficient life without using electricity or running water.

notes:
Composed of {自|じ} (self) and ⟦{足|そく}→足：00992_soku⟧ (be sufficient, suffice). Refers to meeting one's own needs or being satisfied with what one has. In modern Japanese, {自足|じそく} rarely appears on its own — it is most commonly encountered as part of the four-character idiom ⟦{自給自足|じきゅうじそく}→自給自足：16264_jikyuujisoku⟧ (self-sufficiency: producing and consuming one's own goods).

USAGE:
- As a noun: {自足|じそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a self-sufficient life)
- As a suru-verb: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自足|じそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to supply one's own vegetables)
- Often combined: {自給|じきゅう}{自足|じそく} (the standard idiomatic form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自給|じきゅう}{自足|じそく}: self-sufficiency (idiomatic four-character compound)
- {自足|じそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: a self-sufficient life
- {自足|じそく}⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: cannot supply one's own / cannot be satisfied
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自足|じそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to meet one's own food needs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自給|じきゅう}→自給：23675_jikyuu⟧: self-supply — the more common half of ⟦{自給自足|じきゅうじそく}→自給自足：16264_jikyuujisoku⟧; emphasizes production
- ⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧: independence — broader; includes political and emotional independence
- ⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧: independence, standing on one's own — focuses on personal autonomy rather than supplying one's needs
- ⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧: satisfaction, contentment — emphasizes feeling, not supply
